title: Build a Grounded Robot Perception Pipeline
summary: Fuse supplied phrase-mask predictions into a calibrated occupancy map and evaluate a synthetic perception release.

stages.title: Ground phrases and masks
stages.description: Follow supplied query outputs and diagnose missing evidence.

stages.title: Calibrate and fuse
stages.description: Unproject masks, apply world transforms, and fuse a count map.

stages.title: Evaluate and gate
stages.description: Combine invalid evidence, latency, and rollback state.
